title: Therapeutic potential of nicorandil vs nebivolol in attenuating PKC/P38MAPK signaling via PPARgamma/KLOTHO/CREB pathway signaling: molecular docking and experimental validation in rat model of unilateral ureteric obstruction.
authors: Khalifa, Amira Karam; Galal, Amr M; Saber, Sameh; El-Sayed, Ahmed F; Alsibaee, Aishah M; Saeedi, Tahani; Alsubhi, Samia; Miski, Samar F; Aboulhoda, Basma Emad; Mohamed, Eman Emad Eldin; Wanas, Hanaa
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦大鼠单侧输尿管梗阻模型中药物对PKC/P38MAPK等信号通路的调控及分子对接，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study is designed to highlight the comparative efficacy of nicorandil (NO donor/K(ATP) opener) vs nebivolol (beta1blocker with NO-induced vasodilatory and antioxidant actions) in a rat model of unilateral ureteric obstruction (UUO) to assess whether mitigating oxidative stress, inflammatory drive, and apoptosis could modulate UUO -driven fibrogenic remolding.Moreover, their therapeutic potential was further assessed by docking analysis. METHODOLOGY: Sham control group (1); UUO Group (2); Group (3): The nicorandil-treated group, in which rats received 15 mg/kg/day following ureteric obstruction for 21 days, and Group (4): the nebivolol-treated group, in which rats received 2 mg/kg/day orally following ureteric obstruction for 21 days. RESULTS: bioinformatically, Notable findings include nebivolol's superior binding affinity to Catalase, TGFbeta1R and LOX-1 and nicorandil's higher affinity to TP53and Smad-3. These interactions suggest that both compounds may mitigate oxidative stress, inflammation, and fibrosis. Nebivolol potentially offers greater renal protection through enhanced suppression of pro-inflammatory signaling. Mechanistically, nebivolol demonstrates superior efficacy through coordinated modulation of key molecular pathways. Nebivolol disrupts the self-amplifying cycle of oxidative stress and inflammation by upregulating SIRT-1, miRNA200a expression restoring Nrf2 activity, and downregulating Keap1 re-establishing redox homeostasis. It further attenuates NF-kappaB-driven proinflammatory signaling and suppresses downstream PKC/p38 MAPK activation, reducing fibrotic and apoptotic responses. Concurrently, nebivolol enhances protective signaling via PPARgamma, Klotho, and CREB, promoting cellular resilience and structural preservation. These multifaceted actions converge to normalize renal function, mitigate tissue injury, and maintain glomerular-tubular integrity. CONCLUSION: By targeting interconnected redox, inflammatory, and apoptotic pathways, nebivolol could emerge as a mechanistically therapeutic candidate, offering promise for repurposing in obstructive nephropathy and potentially in broader contexts of chronic kidney disease characterized by complex molecular dysregulation.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在比较尼可地尔（NO供体/K(ATP)开放剂）与奈比洛尔（具有NO诱导血管舒张和抗氧化作用的β1受体阻滞剂）在单侧输尿管梗阻（UUO）大鼠模型中的相对疗效，以评估减轻氧化应激、炎症驱动和细胞凋亡是否能调节UUO驱动的纤维化重塑。此外，通过对接分析进一步评估了它们的治疗潜力。方法：假手术对照组（1）；UUO组（2）；第（3）组：尼可地尔治疗组，大鼠在输尿管梗阻后接受15 mg/kg/天治疗21天；第（4）组：奈比洛尔治疗组，大鼠在输尿管梗阻后口服接受2 mg/kg/天治疗21天。结果：生物信息学分析显示，显著发现包括奈比洛尔对过氧化氢酶、TGFβ1R和LOX-1具有更优的结合亲和力，而尼可地尔对TP53和Smad-3具有更高的亲和力。这些相互作用表明，两种化合物均可能减轻氧化应激、炎症和纤维化。奈比洛尔可能通过增强对促炎信号传导的抑制，提供更优的肾脏保护。机制上，奈比洛尔通过对关键分子通路的协调调节展现出更优疗效。奈比洛尔通过上调SIRT-1、miRNA200a表达，恢复Nrf2活性，并下调Keap1，重建氧化还原稳态，从而破坏氧化应激和炎症的自我放大循环。它进一步减弱NF-κB驱动的促炎信号传导，并抑制下游PKC/p38 MAPK激活，减少纤维化和凋亡反应。同时，奈比洛尔通过PPARγ、Klotho和CREB增强保护性信号传导，促进细胞韧性和结构保存。这些多方面的作用汇聚于正常化肾功能、减轻组织损伤并维持肾小球-肾小管完整性。结论：通过靶向相互关联的氧化还原、炎症和凋亡通路，奈比洛尔可能成为一种机制性治疗候选药物，为在梗阻性肾病及可能更广泛的以复杂分子失调为特征的慢性肾病背景中的药物再利用提供前景。
